visualReview.review: Reviewed actual 1200x900 preview, full desktop/mobile screenshots and mobile order-dialog image. Slate-blue account panels, clear status badges and original product art remain coherent; mobile tables scroll with an explicit hint, and the order dialog stays readable within its viewport. Corrected nested product-icon sizing after initial screenshot review and recaptured. Real browser checks cover order filtering/tracking/reordering/invoice download/return draft, address create-edit-delete-default, sample-card creation/removal, cart, empty wishlist and alerts, local reviews, profile persistence/photo, password mismatch/success preview, preferences, logout and delete/reopen, including small-screen forms. No authentication, live fulfilment, payment or production account changes are represented.
